question_summary: Request to substitute a fan-coil-based alternate air handling unit in lieu of the specified packaged rooftop AHU due to lead times, pending confirmation of equivalent performance to Section 23 05 00.
proposed_solution: Approve use of a fan-coil-based alternate AHU in place of the specified packaged rooftop AHU with equivalent performance.
deadline_text: Please respond within five business days
routing_rationale: Mechanical Engineer should verify performance equivalence and compatibility of the proposed AHU substitution with Section 23 05 00.
